organisationNumber.description: Represents the unique identification number of an organisation.

source.description: Represents the source of the organisation information.

country.description: Represents the country associated with the organisation.

companyName.description: Represents the name of the company associated with the organisation.

referenceKey.description: Represents the unique key that identifies a specific reference for an organisation.

externalId.description: Represents an optional external identifier for an organisation.
